app.title: Sound Archive
app.tagline: How a place sounded, kept in time.

config.error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

map.label: Map of places
map.canvasLabel: Map. Use the arrow keys to move and the plus and minus keys to zoom.
map.toggleAttribution: Show or hide the map attribution
map.cluster_one: Group of {count} place. Zoom in to see it
map.cluster_other: Group of {count} places. Zoom in to see them

status.empty: No places in this area. Zoom out or use the list.
status.error: Could not load the places in this area.
status.truncated: There are more places than shown: zoom in to see them all.

map.styleError: Could not load the base map. The places are still available in the list.

unavailable.satellite: Satellite not available in this area
unavailable.topo: Topographic map not available in this area

layers.failed: The images for this layer could not be loaded.

locate.promptBody: Your location is used only on your device, to show you on the map. It is neither sent nor saved.

error.denied: Your browser blocks access to your location on this site.
error.deniedHelp: To allow it, open the site settings (the icon next to the web address), find “Location” and choose “Allow”. The map keeps working without it.
error.unavailable: Your location is not available right now. Try again later.
error.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again.
error.unsupported: This browser cannot share your location.

place.recordingsPlaceholder: Recordings of this place will appear here.
place.notFound: This place does not exist or was deleted.
place.noRecordingsBody: Be the first to keep how this place sounds.
place.recordingsError: The recordings could not be loaded.

sheet.handle: Panel height: {height}. Press to change it.

list.label: List of places
list.searchHint: Searches the name and the description.

location.mapLabel: Map for choosing the location. Tap or click to place the pin.
location.longitudeHint: Between −180 and 180. West of Greenwich it is negative, for example: −2.9350.
location.useMineExplain: It is the easiest and most precise way to place it. Your browser will ask for permission, and nothing is saved until you confirm.
location.denied: Your browser blocks access to your location on this site.
location.deniedHelp: To allow it, open the site settings (the icon next to the web address), find “Location” and choose “Allow”, then try again. Meanwhile, you can choose the point on the map.
location.unavailable: Your location is not available right now. Try again or choose the point on the map.
location.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again or choose the point on the map.
location.unsupported: This browser cannot share your location. Choose the point on the map or type the coordinates.
location.recommendTitle: Are you at the place now?
location.lowAccuracy: The location is approximate; you can move the marker.
location.dragHint: Tap the map or drag the marker to adjust the point.
location.osmToggleHint: To suggest them, our server asks OpenStreetMap which sites are in a square of about 300 m. Your exact position and your account are never sent.

details.name: Name
details.descriptionHint: What you can hear, or why this place. Up to {max} characters.

confirm.intro: Check the details before creating the place.

error.network: Could not reach the server. What you typed is still here: try again.
error.server: The server could not save the place (error {status}). What you typed is still here: try again.
error.validation: The server did not accept the details. Go back and check the fields.

disabled.title: Creating places is disabled on this server
disabled.body: There are no user accounts yet, so this server does not let just anyone create places. You can keep exploring the map and the list.

known.existingIntro: There is already a place very close to this point. If it is the same one, you can add your recording or photos to it.
known.existingFound_one: There is {count} place very close. Check whether it is the same.
known.existingFound_other: There are {count} places very close. Check whether it is one of them.
known.distinct: No, it is a different place
known.createWithoutReference: It is another: create it without linking the site
known.externalTitle: Is it one of these sites?
known.externalIntro: If you choose one, we fill in the name and you can still change it.
known.similar: Looks like a place that already exists

validation.nameTooLong: The name has {count} characters; the maximum is {max}.
validation.descriptionTooLong: The description has {count} characters; the maximum is {max}.
validation.latitudeRequired: Type the latitude or choose a point on the map.
validation.latitudeNumber: The latitude must be a number, for example 43.2630.
validation.latitudeRange: The latitude must be between −90 and 90.
validation.longitudeRequired: Type the longitude or choose a point on the map.
validation.longitudeNumber: The longitude must be a number, for example −2.9350.
validation.longitudeRange: The longitude must be between −180 and 180.

account.title: Your account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
account.sessionsBody: If you think someone else has used your account, sign out everywhere.

auth.intro: Sound Archive is private for now. If you do not have an account, you need an invitation.
auth.usernameHint: Only visible if you choose to show your name. 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots or dashes.
auth.registerTitle: Create an account with an invitation
auth.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

error.bad_credentials: That username or password is not right.
error.invalid_invitation: This code is not valid or has already been used. Check it and try again.
error.username_invalid: Use 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
error.username_taken: That username already exists. Choose another one.
error.password_too_short: The password needs at least 12 characters.
error.password_too_common: That password is too common. Choose another one.
error.password_contains_username: The password cannot contain your username.
error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a little before trying again.
error.try_later: The service is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
error.bad_origin: We could not verify where this request came from. Reload the page.
error.bad_csrf: We could not verify your session. Reload the page.
error.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection.
error.server: The server could not complete that. Try again.

player.close: Close the player and stop the sound
player.sleepDone: The timer has finished and the sound has stopped.
player.error: This recording could not be played. Check your connection and try again.

recording.gone: This recording is no longer available.
recording.error: It could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
recording.noHeard: The person who recorded it has not described what you can hear.
recording.removedToast: Recording removed. It is no longer shown to anyone.

report.title: Report
report.body: Tell us briefly what is wrong. Only the administrators will see it.
report.tooShort: Write a reason, even a short one.
report.failed: It could not be sent. Try again.

publish.title: Title
publish.heardHint: A sentence or two for people who cannot listen.
publish.when: Date and time of the recording
publish.author: How you want to appear
publish.visibilityHint: "Public" means any account on this server.
publish.licenseHint: Decides what other people can do with your recording.
publish.deviceHint: For instance, the recorder or microphone you used.
publish.waitingConnection: Connection lost. We will resume when it returns; keep this tab open.
publish.processingBody: We check the format and calculate the fingerprint. The original is not changed.

error.network: We could not reach the server. Your recording is still on this device: try again.
error.tooLarge: The file is over the 2 GB limit.
error.diskFull: The server does not have enough space right now.
error.server: The server could not save the recording. What you wrote is still here: try again.

failure.not_audio: This file does not seem to contain audio.
failure.format_not_allowed: This format is not accepted. Use WAV, FLAC, MP3, M4A, OGG or Opus.
failure.cannot_decode: The audio in this file could not be read; it may be damaged.
failure.processing_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again later.

record.title: Record
record.preBody: We only record while a recording is running. Your browser will ask you next. If you would rather not, you can upload a file.
record.blockedBody: The browser is not letting us use the microphone. Press the padlock in the address bar and allow it, or upload a file.
record.unsupportedBody: It needs a secure connection and access to a microphone. You can upload a file.
record.losslessHint: 24-bit WAV, uncompressed. Up to {minutes} minutes, because it stays on this device until you send it.
record.compressedHint: Lossy compression ({codec}). Takes much less space, but does not keep all the detail.
record.processingNote: We turn off echo cancellation, noise suppression and automatic gain to keep the real sound of the place.
record.stopped: Recording stopped. Listen back before publishing.
record.isLossless: Lossless. The server will analyse it again: its measurement is the one that counts.
record.isCompressed: Lossy compression. The server will analyse it again: its measurement is the one that counts.
record.limitReached: The {minutes}-minute limit was reached and the recording stopped.
record.processingWarning: Your browser could not turn off: {list}. The sound may be altered, and the recording will say so.

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.formats: WAV, FLAC, MP3, M4A or OGG · up to 2 GB
upload.keepOpen: If the connection drops, the upload continues by itself. Keep this tab open until it finishes.

ambient.title: Ambient mode
ambient.noNormalise: We do not normalise the level: it will sound as it was recorded.

compare.title: {place}, across time
compare.needTwo: You need at least two recordings of this place to compare.
compare.note: Both play at the level they were recorded; the difference in loudness is shown and not corrected.

photos.title: Photos
photos.fileHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB. We remove the location and any other hidden data.
photos.altHint: Optional, but it helps people who cannot see it.
photos.caption: Caption (optional)

error.notImage: This file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
error.tooLarge: The image is too large. The maximum is 20 MB and 40 megapixels.
error.limit: You have reached the limit of photos for this place.
error.network: We could not reach the server. Try again.
error.server: The server could not save the photo. Try again.

camera.introTitle: Take a photo with the camera
camera.introBody: Your browser will ask for permission to use the camera. The image only leaves this device if you choose to use it, and the camera turns off as soon as you take the photo.
camera.blocked: Your browser blocks the camera on this site.
camera.blockedHelp: To allow it, open the site settings (the icon next to the web address), find “Camera” and choose “Allow”, then try again.
camera.none: We could not find a camera on this device. You can choose a photo from your files.
camera.error: The camera could not be used. Try again or choose a photo from your files.

admin.title: Administration
admin.removeBody: It will stop being visible to everyone. You can restore it whenever you want.
admin.actionFailed: That could not be done. Try again.

invitation.onlyOnce: Copy this code now: it will not be shown again.

offline.banner: You are offline. You can keep listening to what you have already opened.

diagnosis.title: Location diagnosis
diagnosis.intro: This page asks your browser for your location and writes down what it answers, to find out why the “where am I” button does not work on this device.
diagnosis.privacy: Nothing shown here is sent or stored. When you leave this page, everything stops and is forgotten.

probes.title: Tests
probes.body: Three attempts in a row, about 35 seconds at most. If the browser asks for permission, allow it.

result.ok: success: first reading in {ms} ms, ±{meters} m, {readings} readings

position.title: Does it look right?
position.body: Shows your position here, to two decimals, so you can see whether it is your city or 300 km away. It stays out of the report unless you tick the box.
position.label: Approximate position
position.include: Add the position, rounded to two decimals, to the report

report.heading: Report
report.title: Sound Archive location diagnosis
report.manual: Could not copy automatically: the text is selected so you can copy it by hand.
